headline: Carney discusses with Trump progress toward a trade deal that "respects Canada's sovereignty"
summary: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney discussed with US President Donald Trump progress toward a trade agreement that respects Canada's sovereignty. The talks were reported on Wednesday.
why: Canada and the United States are each other's largest trading partners, so trade terms between them affect tariffs, supply chains and investment across North America.
original_headline: Carney trata con Trump los avances para un acuerdo comercial que "respete la soberanía de Canadá"
